extraction.notes: ESS reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting line is net income available to common stockholders. Casualty loss, impairment from unconsolidated co-investments and co-investment promote income show '-' for the Q4 2024 column and were omitted as zero. The 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' line (32,340) was categorized as re_depreciation; its label includes 'other' so the classification is a judgment call. Shares converted from 66,642,599 to thousands (66,642.599). Checked: FFO 246,014/66,642.6 = $3.69; Core FFO 261,517/66,642.6 = $3.92. Same reconciliation appears on page S-3 (seq 15); the page-6 table was used.
